description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ScreenPermissionDaoTest' which tests the 'ScreenPermissionDao' data access object related to screen permissions in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup, multiple test cases for permissions retrieval, and verification logic.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of ScreenPermissionDao in retrieving screen permissions based on roles and permissions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loads configuration, truncates specific tables, populates with fixture data, and instantiates the DAO object.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermission
methods.description: Tests various scenarios of retrieving screen permissions for different roles and permission combinations, including validation of permission attributes.

methods.name: verifyPermissions
methods.description: Helper method to assert that a permission object's read, create, update, delete rights match expected boolean values.
